props.text: Post-mortem on recent medium-term trading: Cleaned out all MTF positions Friday on daily trend reclaims (SPY/IWM). Medium-term closes yielded minimal profit. Shorter-term plays worked; also closed flat NQ short from earlier week. Attempted QQQ higher-low play yesterday and got burned. Trader reflection: "good analysis but ended up being a waste of time." Sentiment signals frustration and tactical uncertainty—macro bear thesis challenged by underperformance on medium-term strategy.
